name: publications
description: One immutable generation of a program (a group's or a screen's): its exact manifest bytes, their SHA-256, a digest of its content and counts, its publisher and time.
lifecycle: Inserted when a person publishes or restores; never edited. Superseded when the next generation of its program is published; pruned (manifest cleared, media references deleted) by maintenance once it is neither the latest, nor reported in use by a screen within seven days, nor within 90 days of being superseded (AT-18). Deleted only with its program. See docs/project/publication-sync-design.md.

columns.Meaning: Backend-generated immutable publication UUID, also in the manifest.
Company that owns the publication; immutable (tenant key).
Program this publication is a generation of; immutable.

Branches the program concerned when it was published (a group's explicit span or the screen's branch), so the media guard discloses only references the caller may see; empty for a whole-company group.
columns.Null meaning: Never null; an empty array means the program reached the whole company.

columns.Meaning: Generation number within the program, from 1, increasing.
Synchronization protocol the manifest is serialized in.
SHA-256 of the canonical outputs, playlists and media, equal for equal content; republishing unchanged content returns the latest publication.
Exact UTF-8 JSON bytes served to screens, with schedules and media identifiers.
columns.Null meaning: The publication was pruned and can no longer be delivered or restored.

columns.Meaning: SHA-256 of the manifest bytes, which authorization statements name.
Length of the manifest.
Schedule rules across outputs.
Distinct playlists copied.
Playlist items across copied playlists.
Distinct media items referenced.
Total size of the referenced display renditions.
Generation whose content this publication restored.
Principal that published.
Membership through which the publication was made.
PostgreSQL-clock instant of publication.
PostgreSQL-clock instant the next generation was published.
columns.Null meaning: This is the program's latest publication.

columns.Meaning: PostgreSQL-clock instant maintenance pruned the publication.

constraints.Purpose: The branch list is present and bounded.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A publication belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, program_id) REFERENCES programs(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The program belongs to the same company; deleting a group's program deletes its publications.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, published_by_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The publishing membership belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((rule_count >= 0) AND (playlist_count >= 0) AND ((item_count >= 0) AND (item_count <= 2000)) AND ((media_count >= 0) AND (media_count <= 1000)) AND (media_bytes >= 0)))
constraints.Purpose: Counts are not negative and stay within the snapshot limits.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((manifest_size > 0) AND ((manifest IS NULL) OR (octet_length(manifest) = manifest_size))))
constraints.Purpose: The recorded size matches the stored manifest.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((manifest IS NULL) = (pruned_at IS NOT NULL)))
constraints.Purpose: The manifest is kept exactly until the publication is pruned.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((pruned_at IS NULL) OR (superseded_at IS NOT NULL)))
constraints.Purpose: Only a superseded publication can be pruned.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (published_by_principal_id) REFERENCES principals(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The publisher is a known principal.
A restore names an earlier generation.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX publications_company_id_id_key ON public.publications USING btree (company_id, id)
CREATE INDEX publications_company_published_idx ON public.publications USING btree (company_id, published_at)
constraints.Purpose: Counts a company's recent publications for the publish limits.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX publications_generation_key ON public.publications USING btree (company_id, program_id, generation)
constraints.Purpose: One publication per program and generation.
